method: Three illustrative external entry points, not endorsements, partners or verified opportunities. No claim of impact or available vacancies.

entries.name: Local peacebuilding
entries.description: Supports locally led conflict prevention, social cohesion and institutions.
entries.action: Explore current programmes and their published reports. Contact the organisation through its official site for appropriate ways to support.
entries.evidence: Organisation describes its own approach; no independently verified effect estimate attached.
entries.measure: Document community-defined priorities, participation in decisions and independently corroborated outcomes.

entries.name: Unarmed civilian protection
entries.description: Nonviolent approaches to civilian protection and violence prevention.
entries.action: Read about the methodology and official opportunities to support. Do not travel independently into a conflict zone.
entries.evidence: Approach documented in humanitarian practice literature; local effects depend on setting and implementation.
entries.measure: Use locally agreed, privacy-preserving measures of perceived safety and access, with safeguarding oversight.

entries.name: Find local peacebuilders
entries.description: Explore locally rooted peacebuilding stories and organisations by country.
entries.action: Use the directory to discover local expertise; confirm a group's current needs directly before offering help.
entries.evidence: Directory and editorial coverage, not an impact ranking.
entries.measure: Record whether a requested partnership or resource was actually delivered, not just contacts made.
